# PDF.js (vendored)

Mozilla PDF.js **4.0.379** (`pdfjs-dist`) — Apache License 2.0.

- `pdf.min.mjs` — library (ES module)
- `pdf.worker.min.mjs` — web worker

Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdfjs-dist / https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/

Vendored so CV upload works on localhost and GitHub Pages without relying on CDN UMD builds (removed in v4).
